risks.description: A selected executor may be present in support metadata while generated dependencies or runtime behavior silently ignore it.
risks.response: Freeze an exact integration contract before generation and independently validate dependency, AST API use, source identity, and runtime evidence.

risks.description: Incomplete or stale maintenance/security metadata could permit a vulnerable or abandoned exact version to enter an automatic trial.
risks.response: Require bounded GitHub maintenance enrichment, exact-version OSV evaluation, conservative conflict handling, freshness TTLs, and trust PASS before trial.

risks.description: Untrusted external metadata or package code could be mistaken for trustworthy execution capability or leak credentials during a trial.
risks.response: Allowlist endpoints, bound metadata and candidates, require deterministic filters plus isolated timeout-limited trials with a minimal secret-free environment, and fall back to Agent Build.

risks.description: CGKN may resolve a different DashScope account or API method than Attune despite sharing a model name and endpoint host.
risks.response: Prefer the shared QWEN environment contract, match Chat Completions payload semantics, and verify once through the canonical probe.

risks.description: A pre-build Provider stage silently replaces the reviewed route model with an endpoint-incompatible default, preventing the real result and provenance chain from materializing.
risks.response: Thread the resolved routing policy through requirements planning, test exact model selection and all provenance bindings, then perform one bounded live validation.

risks.description: Moving formal specs breaks a loader, test, or documentation reference.
risks.response: Use a specs-first compatibility loader, reference graph, legacy-path scan, schema validation, and compilation of all important flows.

risks.description: Runtime cleanup deletes local user data.
risks.response: Use git rm --cached only; keep local artifacts, workspaces, memories, and historical iteration files ignored and recoverable.

risks.description: Curated evidence is mistaken for delivery authority.
risks.response: Every promoted bundle carries a canonical status, limitations, reproduction command, and explicit support-only authority note.
